long_biography.plain_text:
Driving timber trucks and operating heavy equipment gave Indonesian entrepreneur Haji Isam direct experience of South Kalimantan's mining industry. He learned mine management from a local entrepreneur, then used borrowed capital to rent machinery and take on coal-contracting work. The contracts formed the operating base of Jhonlin Group, the company he founded.

Jhonlin developed logistics alongside mining and moved into palm-oil processing, biodiesel and sugar manufacturing. Those businesses added transport and downstream production to the original coal operation. Andi Syamsuddin Arsyad remains Jhonlin's owner as the group operates in coal mining, palm oil and logistics from South Kalimantan.
